description:
Search for symbols across all supported chains. Returns availability, market data, and crown status.

Params: query (string), chain (string?), status (string?)
Returns: {results: [{symbol, chain, chain_name, status, token_address, market_cap, volume_24h, liquidity, crown_owner}]}
Errors: API_ERROR

query.description: Search query (symbol or partial match, e.g., 'DOGE', 'PEP')

name: search_symbols
title: Search tickers with filters
